samples.summary: Task doc still lists the detached-HEAD shared round directory as a Known limitation, which this delta fixes
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260917-self-review-loop-todo.md:186 reads "A detached HEAD shares one round directory (the branch name is `HEAD`)." This delta adds `branchKey` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:755) and wires it into `cmdReview` (line 875) precisely so a detached HEAD falls back to GITHUB_HEAD_REF / GITHUB_REF_NAME / `detached-<sha>`. The branch's own record of its state is now wrong, and this is the doc the loop's lessons/verification section is read from.

samples.summary: `--fresh` no longer simply "starts over": past the bound it now refuses without `--force`, but the acceptance checklist still records the old contract
samples.evidence: The checklist item at line 57 ("Auto-incrementing `--round`, with `--fresh` to start over") and the verification line 85 ("`--fresh` resets to round 1; `--round 4` prints the bound advisory and still runs") describe behaviour this delta deliberately changes: cmdReview now computes `spentRound = args.fresh ? Math.max(round, nextRound(onDiskBefore)) : round` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:974) and refuses unless `--force`. The behaviour change looks right, but the documented acceptance criterion it satisfies is now stale — a reader following the doc will expect `--fresh` alone to reset after three rounds and will instead hit a refusal.

samples.summary: The bound survives `--fresh` only for one run: `--fresh --force` deletes the rounds, so every later run is measured against an empty store
samples.evidence: `spentRound` is derived from `onDiskBefore` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:949,974), but when `--fresh` is not a dry run the round directories are actually removed (line 954-957). After a single `--fresh --force`, `roundsOnDisk` reports nothing, so rounds 5, 6, 7 … present as 1, 2, 3 and the convergence bound is silently rewound with no record on disk that it was ever exceeded. The delta's own docblock says `--force` is "the only door through", yet one pass through it removes the gate rather than opening it once. A persisted spent-round marker (or not deleting under --force) would match the stated intent.

samples.summary: HEAD-sha read is re-implemented inline rather than reusing `git-env.mjs`'s `readHeadSha`
samples.evidence: cmdReview shells `git(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])` inside a bare try/catch (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:872) while scripts/agent/git-env.mjs:150 already exports `readHeadSha(root)`, which does the same read with the repo-scoped environment this repo's docblock insists on (git location vars stripped so a hook's inherited GIT_DIR cannot redirect the answer). Reuse would also make the round-store key immune to the inherited-GIT_DIR class of bug git-env.mjs was written for.
